propositions: Natural fold launders orphans by retiring and citing pre-snapshot un-cited events in source_event_uuids without replaying their effects, silently converting repairable damage into undetectable loss at the first threshold crossing after a race.

The fold must exclude fsck-defined orphans (active events timestamped before a prior snapshot with uuids absent from that snapshot's source_event_uuids) from both retirement and citation, leaving them live so the ORPHAN_EVENT signal and repair window survive.
A shared is_snapshot_orphan predicate must replace inline orphan definitions in fsck_scan and compact_txn so the two doors cannot drift in their orphan classification.

The defer guard prevents pre-snapshot foldable candidates from folding while their governing snapshot remains young, closing a silent-burial hazard where a new pre-snapshot snapshot would bury the orphan permanently.
Repair-or-plan in fsck_repair must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing to all orphan types, blocking whole-ticket rebuild when a triage orphan is present on the ticket.
